sources: Google Maps places 'Cloudland Canyon State Park' (34.83951,-85.48396) and 'Cloudland Canyon State Park West Rim Campground' (34.83639,-85.48765), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530148 (site details of all 75 'Campsite Electric' sites: 'Electricity Hookup: 50' at sites 01-51, 55, 56 and '30' at 52-54, 57-75; 'Water Hookup: Y' at all; 'Sewer Hookup: Y' at sites 01-19 (not 03), 21, 22, 55, 56, of which 16 are not host sites), read 2026-10-29

values.note: 75 electric RV/tent sites in the West Rim and East Rim campgrounds. Per-site max vehicle length 25-50 ft, so every site takes a 23-ft rig; 21 are pull-through. Sites 01, 02, 21, 22, 55 and 56 are marked Host. 30 walk-in tent, 13 backcountry and 4 pioneer sites besides.

sites.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530148 (every site's Max Vehicle Length / Driveway Entry); https://gastateparks.org/CloudlandCanyon ('75 Tent, Trailer & RV Campsites', '30 Walk-In Campsites', '13 Backcountry Campsites', '4 Pioneer Campsites'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://gastateparks.org/sites/default/files/parks/pdf/trailmaps/parkmaps/cloudland_canyon_sp_2022_sitemap.jpg (Bath-house in both the West Rim and East Rim enlargements; two Dump Station symbols on the park roads), read 2026-10-29

booking.source: https://gastateparks.org/CloudlandCanyon ('Make a Reservation' -> Georgia State Parks' ReserveAmerica site, parkId 530148; every campsite bookable there), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $38 a night for an electric/water back-in site, $42 for a pull-through or full-hookup site, in June 2027 (weekday and Saturday alike); November 2026 is $2 more ($40 / $44). Vehicles need the $10 ParkPass. Read 2026-10-29.

fees.source: https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=GA&parkId=530148 (1-night prices for every site on 2027-06-15: $38.00 / $42.00 Per Night; sites 20 and 07 also on 2027-06-19 ($38 / $42) and 2026-11-10 ($40 / $44)), read 2026-10-29

note:
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
Two campgrounds on the canyon rim, West Rim and East Rim; not on any water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on gastateparks.org + ReserveAmerica + the 2022 site map: 75 electric sites (water; 50 A at 53, 30 A at 22; sewer at 16 public sites), 25-50 ft so all take 23 ft, 21 pull-throughs; $38 back-in / $42 pull-through or full hookup (June 2027), $40/$44 in November 2026; bathhouses + dump. Phone 706-657-4050 matches. Added sewer, max length, deep booking link; fees high raised to 44. Note: first line kept verbatim; counts/hookups/facilities/booking text dropped.
flags: Pin is Google's park pin (34.8395,-85.4840), which sits on the West Rim cottage road, not a campground. Google's 'West Rim Campground' place is 34.83639,-85.48765 (~470 m SW); East Rim campground is across the canyon to the south-east. Suggest re-pinning to the West Rim campground (the larger loop, sites 1-48).
Website lists three URLs; the bare https://gastateparks.reserveamerica.com is redundant beside the parkId=530148 deep link. Suggest https://gastateparks.org/CloudlandCanyon plus the deep link.
November 2026 prices are $2 above June 2027 (site 20 $40 vs $38; site 07 $44 vs $42), so the range is 38-44.
